{{Quote|The Temple's armory stores these artifacts inside its Black Vault.|Mace Windu on Sith weapons, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''Black Vault''' was a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith weapon]] storage space in the [[Jedi Temple armory/Legends|armory]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on<ref name="BoS" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Republic, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] wrote in the [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]] of [[Sorzus Syn]] about recovering the [[Tzuhakk broadsword]] and placing that [[Sith sword]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] Black Vault. Within the chronicle, Windu's notes were in a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] weapons section that was later assembled into the ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="BoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Vault was mentioned in ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', a [[2012]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="BoS" />
